## Appearance

Sukey Pullen has lovely skin, including a smooth, pale neck. She features curly brown hair that is arranged in a stylish hairstyle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)_

## History

Sukey Pullen previously taught school in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford). During her entrance week, she stayed awake for half of each night to cram frantically.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v3 ch.Farewell P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015)_
